VBO:0200844.summary: Under its NKC standard, the Majestic Tree Hound is affectionate and sensitive to kindness or correction. Two-year-old Bull sought attention from anyone who offered it; his keeper described littermate Tank as intelligent and independent. The pair enjoyed country roaming and lawn lounging, but also chased deer for miles.
VBO:0200844.shortDescription: Affectionate in the NKC standard, with Bull’s attention-seeking and Tank’s independent roaming and deer chasing.

sources.title: National Kennel Club — Majestic Tree Hound standard
sources.evidence: Entire actual retained own standard reread. Affectionate and sensitive to kindness/correction; powerful ground-covering hound, long square foreface, very long low soft folded ears, hanging flews/dewlap, substantial functional limbs/knuckled feet, long high-set tapering natural stern with underside hair, dense short coat. No universal peaceful/safety claim adopted.
